status_semantics: A task is VERIFIED only once its CI has actually been read and passed. NEX-089 is VERIFIED: CI 4/4 completed/success on docs head c5a1250, whose product tree is identical to product commit b3130ce. A verdict may be anchored to a docs head only when `git diff <product> <docs-head> -- src/ tests/ frontend/ Dockerfile docker/ .github/` is empty, so the green run tested the identical tree. A run superseded in the concurrency group reads completed/cancelled - never a failure, never evidence. Recurring quirk: pushing product and docs as separate commits on one branch cancels the product commit's own runs, so the verdict must be taken from the docs head and licensed by the empty product diff.
